item.title: GaussiAnimate: Reconstruct and Rig Animatable Categories with Level of Dynamics
item.description: GaussiAnimate compresses the level of dynamics of a 4D shape into compact skelebones that remain both controllable and expressive. See the for the method and qualitative results.

item.title: GGAvatar: Dynamic Facial Geometric Adjustment for Gaussian Head Avatar
item.description: GGAvatar reconstructs high-fidelity animatable Gaussian head avatars from monocular RGB video. Its geometry-aware coarse-to-fine design improves both novel-view rendering and expression animation.
